how: Each model was placed in a generated lab with the first and last Ethernet port of every family cabled to a 2960 collector switch (scripts/census.py). The lab was opened in Packet Tracer 9.0.1 and re-saved; a model is 'ports_verified' when Packet Tracer opened the file and kept those cables under the same port names.

notes.fiber_ports: Packet Tracer drops a copper cable plugged into these; pktforge cannot draw fibre cables yet.
notes.port_renames: The template's saved config uses the left name; Packet Tracer itself calls the port the right name.
notes.extra_device: Packet Tracer adds a 'Power Distribution Device0' to every lab it saves; that is normal.
